name: io.github.chrischall/iaqualink-mcp
description: iAqualink pool equipment: status plus confirm-gated pump, heater, light and set-point control.

environmentVariables.name: IAQUALINK_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The email address you sign in to the iAqualink app with (needed by every tool; the server starts without it)

environmentVariables.name: IAQUALINK_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Your iAqualink password (needed by every tool; the server starts without it)

environmentVariables.name: IAQUALINK_STATUS_CACHE_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds a system's status read is reused before re-polling iAqualink (default 5; 0 disables)

environmentVariables.name: IAQUALINK_WEBTOUCH_STREAM_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Extra hosts (comma-separated) the WebTouch display stream may be served from, beyond webtouch.iaqualink.net and prm.iaqualink.net. Leave unset unless a WebTouch error names a new host
